kcf_main_service.title: Main Service
kcf_main_service.subtitle: Worship. Word. Walk. Work.
kcf_main_service.description: Each week, the KCF family gathers to celebrate the Triune God and our togetherness in His body. Our services blend traditional, contemporary, and vernacular music, creating a unique worship experience that reflects the diversity of our community.

pillars.title: Worship
pillars.description: We blend traditional hymns, contemporary praise, and vernacular music to create a worship experience that honours God and reflects our diverse community.

pillars.title: Word
pillars.description: The whole counsel of God is taught systematically in a manner that is relevant for today. Messages are translated into Bengali, serving the people of this great state.

pillars.title: Walk
pillars.description: KCF is a place where all are welcome. People from across India and the world walk hand in hand, united in faith and fellowship.

pillars.title: Work
pillars.description: We are a community that serves together. Each person who worships at KCF is salt and light in the places where God has placed them.
points: Salt and light in every sphere

kcf_main_service.aboutContent: The family of KCF joins together each week to celebrate the Triune God and our togetherness in His body. We are committed to worship that engages the heart, teaching that transforms the mind, fellowship that builds community, and service that reaches the world. Our services are designed to be accessible, meaningful, and spiritually enriching for everyone who walks through our doors.

hop.title: Hour of Power
hop.subtitle: Start Your Sunday With Prayer
hop.description: Every Sunday at 9:00 AM, we gather for a dedicated time of seeking the face of God. This is the heartbeat of our weekly activities — a sacred hour where we intercede for our world.

prayerFocus.title: Our Nation
prayerFocus.description: Praying for India — its leaders, its people, and its future.

prayerFocus.title: Our State
prayerFocus.description: Interceding for West Bengal and its diverse communities.

prayerFocus.title: Our City
prayerFocus.description: Standing in the gap for Kolkata, the city of joy.

prayerFocus.title: Our World
prayerFocus.description: Lifting up global needs before the throne of grace.

prayerFocus.title: The Church
prayerFocus.description: Praying for churches in Kolkata and across the world.

prayerFocus.title: The KCF Family
prayerFocus.description: Covering our own fellowship in prayer.

hop.aboutContent: The Hour of Power is a cherished tradition at KCF — a time when we set aside the busyness of life to focus on prayer. We believe that prayer is not merely an activity but the very lifeline of our faith. Together, we intercede for our country, our state, our city, our world, churches everywhere, and our own KCF family. This discipline of prayer has been central to our identity from the very beginning.

kids.title: Kids Church
kids.subtitle: Planting Seeds of Faith
kids.description: At KCF, we believe in teaching children biblical truths in a way they can understand and enjoy. Our Kids Church is a vibrant, safe, and nurturing environment for children under 13.

ageGroups.title: Smallies
ageGroups.description: A gentle introduction to God's love through songs, stories, and caring supervision.

ageGroups.title: Beginners
ageGroups.description: Interactive lessons that lay the foundation for a lifelong faith journey.

ageGroups.title: Primaries
ageGroups.description: Deeper exploration of Bible stories with discussions and creative projects.

ageGroups.title: Juniors
ageGroups.description: Preparing pre-teens to understand and own their faith personally.

kids.approachContent: Children first join the main church for worship before leaving for their own time of enthusiastic singing and age-appropriate learning. Our curriculum is designed to be engaging, interactive, and biblically sound. We believe that investing in children today builds the church of tomorrow.

features.title: Biblical Foundation
features.description: Every lesson is rooted in Scripture, teaching children the timeless truths of God's Word.

features.title: Creative Learning
features.description: Through crafts, music, drama, and storytelling, children encounter faith in memorable ways.

features.title: Safe Environment
features.description: All volunteers are vetted and trained, ensuring a secure and loving space for every child.

tot.title: Teens on Track
tot.subtitle: Don't Let Anyone Look Down on You
tot.description: TOT is a vibrant community where teenagers connect, grow, and discover their purpose in Christ. Meeting every 2nd and 4th Sunday, it is a place to recharge and refuel.

scripture.verse: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.

features.title: Worship
features.description: Contemporary worship that speaks to the teenage heart and draws them into God's presence.

features.title: Prayer
features.description: Teaching teens the power and discipline of prayer in their daily lives.

features.title: Bible Study
features.description: Relevant, engaging Bible studies that address the real challenges teenagers face.

features.title: Fellowship
features.description: Building lasting friendships and a supportive community that extends beyond Sunday.

tot.aboutContent: With the demanding schedule of a high schooler — school, studies, tuition classes, and exams — TOT provides a rest from the hectic pace. Students come together for worship, prayer, Bible study, and fellowship. Through social media and connect groups, our teens and teachers stay connected throughout the week. TOT plays a vital role in the KCF family, and we invite you to come and see what the joy is about.

freedom.title: Freedom Church
freedom.subtitle: Hope and Healing for Survivors
freedom.description: Freedom Church is a unique ministry that brings hope and healing to survivors of trafficking. Established in July 2015, it is a caring worshipping community for traumatised and vulnerable women.

pillars.title: Hope and Healing
pillars.description: Bringing the love of Christ to those who have experienced deep trauma and pain.

pillars.title: Caring Community
pillars.description: Building a family where every woman feels loved, valued, and supported.

pillars.title: Strategic Partnership
pillars.description: Working alongside like-minded organisations to maximise impact and reach.

pillars.title: Safe Sanctuary
pillars.description: Providing a secure space where survivors can worship, heal, and rebuild their lives.

freedom.aboutContent: Over the past several years, the KCF family has had the joy of partnering alongside like-minded bodies in the city with the desire to bring hope and healing to survivors of trafficking. God opened a new door as part of His great plan, and we were able to establish Freedom Church in July 2015. This church meets in the Thakurpukur area and seeks to minister to survivors in a manner that is relevant, compassionate, and transformative.

college.title: College and Career
college.subtitle: Strengthening Faith and Friendship
college.description: CnC is a dynamic community for college students and young professionals. It provides a platform to explore biblical answers to the challenges of our time.

focusAreas.title: Biblical Exploration
focusAreas.description: In-depth study of Scripture, from the Gospel of John to Hebrews and Revelation.

focusAreas.title: Relevant Discussions
focusAreas.description: Addressing real issues — stress management, justice, truth, and ethics in a complex world.

focusAreas.title: Community Service
focusAreas.description: Active engagement in gospel outreaches and community service projects.

focusAreas.title: Faith and Friendship
focusAreas.description: Building lasting relationships centred on shared faith and common purpose.

college.aboutContent: College and Career (CnC) was started with the desire of strengthening faith and friendship among the church youth. It focuses mainly on college students and young professionals, providing a platform where young adults can discuss and explore biblical answers relevant to the challenges of the present time. Over the years, we have addressed a wide array of topics ranging from the Ten Commandments to stress management, from discerning truth to euthanasia. We have also undertaken detailed book studies on the Gospel of John, Hebrews, and Revelation. The group has actively engaged in many gospel outreaches and community service projects.

mentorship.title: Bengali Mentorship
mentorship.subtitle: Empowering Future Leaders
mentorship.description: A monthly program designed to empower and equip future Bengali leadership through practical theology and lifestyle learning.

focusPoints.title: Practical Theology
focusPoints.description: Topics chosen for discussion are intentionally focused on practical day-to-day challenges and how to address them as people of faith.

focusPoints.title: Lifestyle Learning
focusPoints.description: Examining lives that have impacted the Bengali people, drawing principles for effective service.

focusPoints.title: Leadership Development
focusPoints.description: Equipping the next generation of Bengali leaders for ministry and community impact.

focusPoints.title: Cultural Relevance
focusPoints.description: Engaging with Bengali culture and heritage while remaining rooted in biblical truth.

mentorship.aboutContent: This is a monthly program specifically designed to empower and equip future Bengali leadership. We meet on the first Sunday of every month. The focus is twofold: Practical Theology — addressing day-to-day challenges through a biblical lens, and Lifestyle Learning — drawing principles from lives that have impacted the Bengali people. Our desire is to see a new generation of leaders rise up to serve this great state effectively.

rajarhat.title: Rajarhat Fellowship
rajarhat.subtitle: A Growing Community in New Town
rajarhat.description: The work in Rajarhat began in February 2015, reaching the new and upcoming settlement of Kolkata with the love of Christ.
rajarhat.location: Community Hall, Rose Dale Plaza, New Town

milestones.title: First Meeting
milestones.description: Initial meetings began in the homes of members from the Rajarhat area.

milestones.title: Novotel Hotel
milestones.description: For the next six months, the fellowship met at the Novotel Hotel.

milestones.title: Pastor's Home
milestones.description: The fellowship then gathered at Pastor Ashok Andrews' home for ten months.

milestones.title: Care Groups
milestones.description: Four care groups established across New Town, meeting weekly.

milestones.title: Sunday Worship
milestones.description: Regular worship services at Rose Dale Plaza with Kids Church and TOT programs.

rajarhat.aboutContent: The work in Rajarhat began keeping in view that this was a new and upcoming settlement of housing in Kolkata, and that KCF had started having families coming from this area. From humble beginnings in members' homes, the fellowship has grown into a vibrant church community meeting at Rose Dale Plaza each Sunday. We are excited that God has given us a dedicated team that runs a Kids Ministry and a Teens on Track program. The fellowship continues to grow through weekly care groups spread across four locations in New Town.
